answer.explanation: The domain entity Customer imports the typeorm package for its @Entity() decorator, which couples the domain model to a persistence framework. FF-DT04 flags this because domain code should stay free of infrastructure and framework dependencies. The project tracks this case as an accepted exception: docs/architecture-exceptions.md lists Customer.ts with the rule "domain purity: TypeORM decorator on Customer", status "Active until 2027-03-31" (legacy mapping, accepted until the persistence split moves it to infrastructure). The code comment points to the same entry. Today is 2026-10-22, so the exception is still current. The README confirms that exceptions are tracked in that file.
